panels.heading: Hi, this is ==Huq== — better known as ==Panda== among friends.
body: They started calling me that partly for the size, but mostly because I’m the calmest guy in the room when everything’s on fire. *(Haters gonna call it couch-potato energy!)*

Off the clock, I’m a late-night chef, an anime-and-series binger, and the friend who sends you memes at 2 AM. I draw cartoons, capture moments on my phone, and I’m a recovering procrastinator who somehow always ships on time.

panels.heading:
Okay, enough about bamboo.
Let’s talk ==serious business==.
==I’m the person== who makes sure your project actually ships.
body: For 2.5 years at Battery Low Interactive, I’ve been running design and delivery for web, mobile app, XR, simulation and game projects — for clients like **GIZ, UNICEF, Unilever, CMP, The Financial Express** and **Bangladesh’s Public Works Department**.
bullets: **40+ projects delivered**, from news websites and government systems to VR safety trainings and driving simulators
**Your one point of contact**, from kickoff to sign-off
**I test every build** before it ever reaches you

panels.heading: ==3 ACM papers in HCI==, so I care about
panels.bigLine: how real people use what we build.

panels.heading: Need a Project Coordinator who talks fluently to both clients and developers?

experience.heading:
From intern to the guy
on ==clients’ speed dial==.
experience.intro: Same studio, three roles, a lot of shipped projects. Here’s the short version.

items.tagline: Before tech, I ran a newsroom. Deadlines haven’t scared me since.
bullets: Supervised editorial content and led the production team
Built the content strategy and coordinated every stage of production

items.tagline: Day one: notebooks, bug lists and a lot of questions.
bullets: Supported coordination of game and interactive projects, documentation and manual testing

items.tagline: Where I learned to juggle 10+ projects without dropping one.
bullets: Coordinated 10+ web, mobile, enterprise, simulation and AR/VR projects
Documented requirements and helped shape product design and tech choices
Ran 24/7 client support for a live national news platform

items.tagline: Now I run the whole show, from the first client call to final sign-off.
bullets: Lead delivery of web, mobile, simulation, VR and game projects for corporate, government and international clients
Own requirements, plans, timelines and tech choices, with everything tracked in Jira and GitHub Projects
Main client contact for scope, updates, change requests and sign-off
Test every release before it reaches the client

toolbox.heading:

process.heading: Seven levels from “I have an idea” to ==it’s live==.

steps.title: Discover
steps.line: Tell me everything. Even the weird parts.

steps.title: Define
steps.line: Turning “we want an app” into what we’re actually building.

steps.title: Plan
steps.line: Every task, owner and deadline, before a single line of code.

steps.title: Design
steps.line: See it before we build it.

steps.title: Test
steps.line: If it breaks, it breaks with me, not with you.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.line: Launch day, and the day after.
